lines.en: Racing through shadows.
Chasing your footsteps.
Slipping through darkness.
Following your movements.
Sprinting in darkness.
Avoiding your gaze.
Gliding in moonlight.
Rushing through night wind.
Passing through your shadow.
Swiftly circling you.

lines.zh: 它贴着梦魇第三层的石壁滑行。
lines.en: It skims along the stone of the Nightmare's third layer.

lines.zh: 冲刺前它先低低伏下身子。
lines.en: Before a dash it drops low to the ground.
Patiently waiting.
Wandering in darkness.
Crouching in shadows.
Hiding in shadows.
Observing quietly.
Pacing in shadows.

lines.zh: 第三层的风，吹不动我的壳。
lines.en: Layer Three's wind cannot move my shell.
Lurking quietly.
Creeping quietly.

lines.zh: 第三层的暗处我藏好了。
lines.en: I'm hidden in the third layer's dark.
Watching your movements.
Tracking your movements.

lines.zh: 光亮的珍珠，还挂在我身上。
lines.en: The bright pearl is still hanging on me.
Staring at your silhouette.
Watching your breath.

lines.zh: 我冲过来之前，只看你一眼。
lines.en: Before I charge, I take one look at you.
Watching your every move.
Noticing your actions.
Staring into your eyes.

lines.zh: 它偏过头，算你到它的距离。
lines.en: It tilts its head, measuring the distance to you.
My dreams shattered...
It hurts too much to think.
My ideals shattered...
My world of dreams...
This is too painful...
Ideals shattered...
Nothing is as I imagined...
Dreams shattered...
This is worse than pain...
My dreams trampled...

lines.zh: 你手上的食物让我跃跃欲试！
lines.en: The food in your hand tempts me!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的速度与激情吧！
lines.en: Feel the speed and passion!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，我是你的噩梦！
lines.en: Nightfall, your nightmare comes!
Nightmare realm, my home!

lines.zh: 珍珠是我们的宝贝，别让别人夺走！
lines.en: Pearls are our treasure, don't let others take them!

lines.zh: 靠近我就准备好被攻击吧！
lines.en: Get close and prepare for an attack!

lines.zh: 黑暗中我最闪耀，别让光芒远离！
lines.en: In the darkness, I shine the brightest!

lines.zh: 我是梦魇的使者，恐惧的化身！
lines.en: I am the messenger of nightmares, the embodiment of fear!

lines.zh: 你的光芒引来了我的怒火！
lines.en: Your light provokes my anger!

lines.zh: 靠近我就让你见识我的利爪！
lines.en: Get close and see my sharp claws!
Move, I’m about to collide!

lines.zh: 我的速度让你措手不及！
lines.en: My speed takes you by surprise!
Let’s have a high-speed showdown!

lines.zh: 你的动作太慢了，躲不开我！
lines.en: Your movements are too slow, you can’t avoid me!
Avoid me, or you’ll get hurt!

lines.zh: 撞击是我们的沟通方式！
lines.en: Collision is our way of communicating!

lines.zh: 你的方向感真差，我来引导你！
lines.en: Your sense of direction is poor, let me guide you!

lines.zh: 别以为你能躲过我，我来了！
lines.en: Don’t think you can avoid me, here I come!

lines.zh: 我的速度比你想象的快！
lines.en: My speed is faster than you think!

lines.zh: 这次你能躲开吗？看好了！
lines.en: Can you dodge this time? Watch out!

lines.zh: 冲刺追你，追上了就一起。
lines.en: I'll dash after you — if I catch you.

lines.zh: 与我同行，一起遨游梦魇！
lines.en: Travel with me, explore the nightmare together!
Only a partner can understand me!

lines.zh: 一起在梦魇中留下足迹！
lines.en: Leave footprints together in the nightmare!

lines.zh: 寻找属于我们的情侣吧！
lines.en: Find a partner for us!

lines.zh: 你就是我的另一半，我找到了！
lines.en: You are my partner, I’ve found you!

lines.zh: 与我一起，你将不再孤单！
lines.en: Travel with me, and you won’t be alone!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是独一无二的！
lines.en: My partner is one of a kind!
We are a pair in the nightmare!
To find you, is an honor!

lines.zh: 放浪者飘过你的头顶，落下一颗珍珠。
lines.en: Bohemite glides above you, dropping a pearl.
The pearl falls and you pick it up.

lines.zh: 这珍珠是放浪者的遗物。
lines.en: This pearl is a Bohemite's遗物.

lines.zh: 珍珠闪烁着微弱的光芒。
lines.en: The pearl glows faintly.

lines.zh: 捡起珍珠，为你的旅途增添光彩。
lines.en: Pick up the pearl and brighten your journey.

lines.zh: 珍珠在你手中发出光芒。
lines.en: The pearl lights up in your hand.
A pearl from a Bohemite.

lines.zh: 这颗珍珠带着它的秘密。
lines.en: This pearl holds secrets.
The pearl is a Bohemite's gift.

lines.zh: 珍珠落下来，你弯腰捡起。
lines.en: The pearl falls and you bend to pick it up.
Nightmare's third layer: I break into a run.
Bohemite locks on to its prey.
Bohemite is fixing its gaze on you.
Target within attack range.
Bohemite prepares to charge.
Lock on and strike down the prey.
Bohemite has its target.
Target is in Bohemite's sights.

lines.zh: 梦魇第三层，我先冲过去。
lines.en: Nightmare layer three; I charge first.
Bohemite is about to charge.
It lowers its weight like a coiled spring.

lines.zh: 它的脚尖在石地上刮了一下。
lines.en: Its toe scrapes once on the stone.
It picks you and flicks its tail.

lines.zh: 它退后半步，让出冲刺的路。
lines.en: It backs off half a step to clear a run-up.

lines.zh: 它把目标钉在你站的那块地上。
lines.en: It pins its mark on the ground you stand on.

lines.zh: 第三层的风停了，它要动了。
lines.en: The wind on the third layer dies; it is about to move.
Rapid charge, capture the prey.

lines.zh: 放浪者以惊人的速度攻击。
lines.en: Bohemite attacks at incredible speed.

lines.zh: 放浪者的速度无人能敌。
lines.en: Bohemite's speed is unmatched.
Quick lock-on, Bohemite strikes.

lines.zh: 放浪者的冲刺令人生畏。
lines.en: Bohemite's charge is intimidating.
Rapidly approach the target.

lines.zh: 放浪者以惊人的速度靠近。
lines.en: Bohemite approaches with incredible speed.
Bohemite swiftly locks onto the target.

lines.zh: 放浪者以惊人的速度冲刺。
lines.en: Bohemite charges at incredible speed.
Quickly lock on to the target.

lines.zh: 它把身体压成一条直线。
lines.en: It flattens its body into a straight line.

lines.zh: 它的爪尖在地面磨出白痕。
lines.en: Its claws scour white marks in the floor.

lines.zh: 它算好了撞上你的那一点。
lines.en: It has worked out the exact point to hit.

lines.zh: 它左右晃了两下，骗你的眼。
lines.en: It feints left and right to fool your eyes.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸短促，越来越快。
lines.en: Its breathing comes shorter and faster.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝盖，那里先垮。
lines.en: It stares at your knees; they give first.

lines.zh: 它把冲刺的距离缩到最短。
lines.en: It shortens its run-up to nothing.
It hisses once, as if counting down.
Its shadow charges before it does.

lines.zh: 它等你脚落地的那一瞬。
lines.en: It waits for the instant your foot lands.

lines.zh: 尖啸划破夜空，你无处可逃！
lines.en: Screams slice through the night; nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 利爪破风而来，恐惧在心！
lines.en: Claws slice through the wind; fear in the heart.
Pearl glows; lethal strike.

lines.zh: 狂奔如野兽，你无处可逃！
lines.en: Rushing like a beast; nowhere to hide.
Glimmering light; danger nears.

lines.zh: 夜影急袭，恐惧无处遁形！
lines.en: Night shadow rushes; fear nowhere to flee.
Torrential attacks of wind.
Light guides the path to death.

lines.zh: 光与暗的对决，你将倒下！
lines.en: Light and dark clash; you fall.

lines.zh: 光芒如剑，斩向你的灵魂！
lines.en: Light like a sword, slicing your soul.
It slams its skull into your waist.

lines.zh: 疾冲带起的风先刮到你。
lines.en: The wind of its charge hits you first.

lines.zh: 它掠过，爪在你肋上留了三道。
lines.en: It streaks past, leaving three lines on your ribs.

lines.zh: 它撞完立刻弹开，重新加速。
lines.en: It rebounds off the hit and accelerates again.

lines.zh: 它的肩骨顶得你喘不上气。
lines.en: Its shoulder knocks the wind out of you.

lines.zh: 它从你侧后冲来，避无可避。
lines.en: It comes from your flank, impossible to dodge.

lines.zh: 它把你撞向第三层的石柱。
lines.en: It drives you into a third-layer pillar.

lines.zh: 它刹不住，撞碎了身后一块石。
lines.en: It cannot stop and shatters a stone behind it.
It licks the blood off its claws.

lines.zh: 它的珍珠在冲刺时晃出光。
lines.en: Its pearl swings out a gleam as it charges.
Fears arise from dreams.
Layer three, abyss of night.
Nightfall, bohemites arrive.
Appearance in darkness; source of fear.
Nightmare light, igniting fear.
Layer three, bohemites' domain.
Night's depths, bohemites awaken.
Nightmares, bohemites appear.
Layer three, bohemites' call.
Darkness, bohemites emerge.

lines.zh: 第三层的暗处，它先动了一下。
lines.en: In the third layer's dark, something first stirs.

lines.zh: 梦魇的石廊里传来疾跑的声。
lines.en: Running footsteps come down the nightmare corridor.
Fire devours my dreams...
Falling tears apart my hope...
Water drowned my fantasy...
Explosion tears my dreams...
Arrow pierces my vision...
Magic burns my imagination...
Hunger devours my hope...
Lightning splits my dreams...
Void devours my ideal...
